scenes.text: 3 mahine se *nahi aaye* customers ki list nikaalo.
scenes.say: Sunday ka kaam. Teen mahine se nahi aaye customers ki list nikaalo.

scenes.text: Naya customer laane se *purana bulana* sasta hai.
scenes.say: Kyunki naya customer laane se purana customer wapas bulana sasta hai.

scenes.title: Unhe *ye* bhejo:
scenes.name: Your Business

msgs.text: Hi [naam] 🙂 kaafi time ho gaya! Pichli baar aapne *[service]* liya tha.
Is mahine aapke liye *[chhota offer]*, sirf [date] tak. Slot chahiye to "HA" likh dijiye.

scenes.say: Naam, pichli service, chhota offer, aur ek word ka reply.

scenes.title: Dhyan rakho:
items: Mahine mein *1 baar se zyaada* nahi
scenes.say: Har message naam ke saath. Offer ki last date. Aur mahine mein ek baar se zyaada nahi.

scenes.sub: Comment WAPAS: message + list banane ka tareeka
scenes.say: Comment karo WAPAS, template bhejenge. Ya seedha WhatsApp karo, hum aapke liye set kar denge.

caption:
Aapke phone mein sabse bada chhupa paisa: wo customers jo 3 mahine se nahi aaye. 💸

Sunday ka 20 min ka kaam:
1️⃣ List nikaalo: 90 din se nahi aaye
2️⃣ Naam + pichli service + chhota offer
3️⃣ "HA" reply ka option
4️⃣ Last date zaroor

Mahine mein 1 baar se zyaada nahi. Save karo 🔖
Comment "WAPAS" 👇
